context: Initially nums = [2, 4, 1, 0, 3, 5], with indices 0 through 5. The current boundaries are left = 0 and right = 5. Choose the leftmost element, nums[left] = 2, as the pivot.

The left pointer i scans right for the first element greater than the pivot. The right pointer j scans left for the first element smaller than the pivot. This implementation moves j before i on every iteration, and both scans require i < j. Swap the two misplaced elements when both are found. Continue until the pointers meet, then swap the pivot into their meeting position.
description: Above the code, the figure shows nums, the pivot marker, the range boundaries left and right, and the scanning pointers i and j. The partition function below highlights the current statement in gray. Until the final swap to the boundary, the pivot 2 stays at index 0 while i scans right. The boundaries left = 0 and right = 5 stay fixed throughout. Only their labels are hidden in the final state.

frames.announcement: Initialize i = 0 and j = 5, and choose the leftmost element, 2, as the pivot.
frames.explanation: Initially nums = [2, 4, 1, 0, 3, 5]. Choose 2 at index 0 as the pivot. The gray highlighted statement i, j = left, right sets i = 0 and j = 5, pointing to 2 and 5, respectively. No scan or swap has occurred.
frames.key_state: Now nums = [2, 4, 1, 0, 3, 5], i = 0, and j = 5. The pivot 2 is at index 0.
frames.title: Initialize the boundaries, pivot, and two pointers

frames.announcement: Pointer j moves left past 5 and 3 and stops at 0 at index 3.
frames.explanation: Move j first. The 5 at index 5 and the 3 at index 4 are both at least 2, so skip them. At index 3, 0 < 2, so stop. Now nums = [2, 4, 1, 0, 3, 5], i = 0, and j = 3. The pivot 2 remains at index 0.
frames.key_state: Now nums = [2, 4, 1, 0, 3, 5], i = 0, and j = 3. The pivot 2 is at index 0. Pointer j stops at 0 because it is smaller than 2.
frames.title: Pointer j scans left and finds 0, smaller than the pivot

frames.announcement: Pointer i moves right and stops at 4 at index 1, ready to swap with the 0 at j.
frames.explanation: Move i next. The 2 at index 0 is no greater than the pivot 2, so skip it. At index 1, 4 > 2, so stop. Now nums = [2, 4, 1, 0, 3, 5], with i = 1 pointing to 4 and j = 3 pointing to 0. These two elements are ready to swap. The pivot 2 remains at index 0.
frames.key_state: Now nums = [2, 4, 1, 0, 3, 5], i = 1, and j = 3. The pivot 2 is at index 0. Pointer i stops at 4 because it is greater than 2. The pair is ready to swap.
frames.title: Pointer i scans right and finds 4, greater than the pivot

frames.announcement: Swap 4 at index 1 with 0 at index 3.
frames.explanation: Swap 4 at index 1 with 0 at index 3. This moves 0, smaller than the pivot, to the left and 4, larger than the pivot, to the right. Now nums = [2, 0, 1, 4, 3, 5], i = 1, and j = 3. The pivot 2 remains at index 0.
frames.key_state: Now nums = [2, 0, 1, 4, 3, 5], i = 1, and j = 3. The pivot 2 is at index 0. Indices 1 and 3 have been swapped.
frames.title: Swap 4 and 0

frames.announcement: Pointer j moves left from 4 to 1 at index 2.
frames.explanation: Move j first on the next iteration. The 4 at index 3 satisfies 4 ≥ 2, so move left to index 2. There 1 < 2, so stop. Now nums = [2, 0, 1, 4, 3, 5], with i = 1 pointing to 0 and j = 2 pointing to 1. The pivot 2 remains at index 0.
frames.key_state: Now nums = [2, 0, 1, 4, 3, 5], i = 1, and j = 2. The pivot 2 is at index 0. Pointer j stops at 1 because it is smaller than 2.
frames.title: Pointer j continues left and finds 1, smaller than the pivot

frames.announcement: Pointer i moves right to index 2, meets j, and stops scanning.
frames.explanation: At index 1, 0 ≤ 2, so i moves right to index 2 and meets j. Now nums = [2, 0, 1, 4, 3, 5] and i = j = 2. The meeting position holds 1, and the pivot 2 remains at index 0. The inner scan for i stops because i < j no longer holds, not because it found an element greater than the pivot.
frames.key_state: Now nums = [2, 0, 1, 4, 3, 5], i = 2, and j = 2. The pivot 2 is at index 0. The pointers have met, but the self-swap has yet to occur.
frames.title: Pointer i moves right to meet j

frames.announcement: Both pointers refer to the same position. Swapping it with itself leaves the data unchanged, and the outer partition loop ends.
frames.explanation: Execute the swap of nums[i] and nums[j] at the end of the iteration. Since i = j = 2, the 1 at index 2 swaps with itself. The array remains nums = [2, 0, 1, 4, 3, 5], with the pivot 2 at index 0. The condition i < j is now false, so the outer partition loop ends.
frames.key_state: Now nums = [2, 0, 1, 4, 3, 5], i = 2, and j = 2. The pivot 2 is at index 0. The self-swap is complete, the array is unchanged, and the outer partition loop ends.
frames.title: Swapping the meeting position with itself leaves the array unchanged

frames.announcement: Swap the pivot 2 at index 0 with the 1 at the meeting position, index 2, putting the pivot in place.
frames.explanation: After the loop, swap the pivot 2 at index 0 with the 1 at index 2. Now nums = [1, 0, 2, 4, 3, 5] and i = j = 2. The pivot 2 is at its final index, 2.
frames.key_state: Now nums = [1, 0, 2, 4, 3, 5], i = 2, and j = 2. The pivot 2 is at index 2.
frames.title: Swap pivot 2 into the boundary position at index 2

frames.announcement: Partitioning is complete and returns index 2. The left and right subarrays still need recursive sorting.
frames.explanation: The statement return i returns index 2. Now nums = [1, 0, 2, 4, 3, 5]. The figure hides left, right, i, and j. Braces mark the left subarray [1, 0] (indices 0 through 1) and right subarray [4, 3, 5] (indices 3 through 5). All left elements are ≤ 2 and all right elements are ≥ 2, but both subarrays are still unsorted.
frames.key_state: Return index 2. Now nums = [1, 0, 2, 4, 3, 5]. The left subarray [1, 0] and right subarray [4, 3, 5] still need recursive sorting. The pointers are hidden.
frames.title: Finish one partition, leaving the left and right subproblems

result: One partition fixes only the pivot's final position. Each side still needs to be sorted recursively.
summary: Move the right pointer j first, then the left pointer i. Swap elements on the wrong sides, then place the pivot 2 at the boundary.
title: One two-pointer partition with pivot 2
